input.query: WITH x AS (SELECT channel, variant, COUNT(*) n, AVG(CASE WHEN conv_14d THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) p, AVG(margin_60d_eur) m, AVG(bonus_cost_eur) b FROM fct_experiment_users GROUP BY 1,2), p AS (SELECT a.channel, (a.p-b.p) lift, a.n tn,b.n cn, a.m tm,b.m cm,a.b bonus, (a.b/(a.p-b.p)) incentive_per_incremental, (a.m-b.m) margin_diff FROM x a JOIN x b USING(channel) WHERE a.variant='treatment' AND b.variant='control') SELECT *, 10.0 AS converted_user_worth_proxy FROM p
